Specials: S1 "Nyanko-sensei & the First Errand / Nyanko-sensei to Hajimete no Otsukai" = S0E1 "Nyanko-sensei and First Errand" (TheTVDB: ニャンコ先生とはじめてのおつかい); S2 "One Night's Cups / Ichiya Sakazuki" = S0E3 "One Night Sake Cup" (一夜盃) by the row 2-3; S3 "Banquet of Play / Yuugi no Utage" = S0E4 "Party of Fun & Game" (遊戯の宴) by the row 3-4.
